title: Finite coproduct comparison for Cech complexes over an etale object
statement: Let X be a scheme, U an object of its small etale category, I a finite type in Type (u+1), V_i etale X-schemes with arrows f_i to U. Let W be an etale X-scheme with g:W→U and c_i:V_i→W, whose underlying scheme cofan is a coproduct and c_i followed by g equals f_i. For every abelian sheaf G on X_et, the Mathlib Cech complexes in Over U for (f_i) and the singleton (g) with the restricted G are isomorphic. No covering or affineness hypothesis is imposed. [def-weil-pbc-cech-complex] [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]

source.place: Tag 03OZ, equation 59.22.1.1 and the fibre-product coproduct formula in the proof; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03OZ

proof.text: Restrict G to the slice over U and transport it through the proved upstream Etale.overSheafEquiv to U.left.smallEtaleTopology; Etale.overEquiv preserves finite products and projections. Reindex I by Fin n, including the tuple products and omitted-factor maps. Use the cofan universal property to identify W with the canonical coproduct. Apply fibre-product distribution over that finite coproduct to identify each singleton iterated product with the coproduct of the indexed family products, with projection compatibility.

Restrict G to the disjoint summands. Its sheaf axiom identifies sections with their product, by the disjoint-cover restriction isomorphism. The summands remain etale objects over X. Empty summands and the empty family use terminal sections on the empty scheme.

Compare the chosen fibre products with Mathlib products in Over U. The distribution projection equations show the restriction maps commute with every face and hence their alternating sums. Take the degreewise inverse to orient the complex isomorphism from the family to the singleton.

theorem nonempty_etale_over_coproduct_cech_iso
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Etale) (I : Type (u + 1)) [Finite I]
    (V : I → X.Etale) (f : ∀ i : I, V i ⟶ U)
    (W : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ U) (c : ∀ i : I, V i ⟶ W)
    (hc : IsColimit (Cofan.mk W.left (fun i ↦ (c i).left)))
    (hw : ∀ i : I, c i ≫ g = f i)
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    Nonempty (((cechComplexFunctor fun i : I ↦ Over.mk (f i)).obj
      ((Over.forget U).op ⋙ G.obj)) ≅
      ((cechComplexFunctor fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ Over.mk g).obj
        ((Over.forget U).op ⋙ G.obj)))
